connector.name: Jarvis Market Signals
connector.registryDescription: Live crypto market signals for AI agents: perp liquidations, funding, OI positioning, yield, FX.
connector.summary: Hosted at jarvis.tail12fa6b.ts.net over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the casterdly account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <key>. Free key (100 calls/day): open an issue at github.com/Casterdly/jarvis-market-signals. Discovery (initialize/tools/list) needs no key.
